comment: The regulation of NGOs are necessary. Though it can lead to silencing. Some NGOs do good work needed by the society.
title: The threat of a restrictive NGO law looms over Slovakia

comment: Corrupt, unpopular governments distracting from their problems by ignoring their issues and limiting public information is a story as old as time. It's almost tradition at this point. It's unfortunate that so many people will accept that things have just always been this way. Hopefully the activists and the press and the rest can come together and put a stop to these kinda actions.
title: Papua New Guinea’s new media rules could undermine the work of journalists

comment: It is good to see that an unsolved murder seems to be closer to being solved. I am concerned with all the jubilation over someone being charged in this case. Everyone seems to be acting as this person is guilty when it is just a charge. It is very frightening when we are immediately assumed to be guilty on just an accusation. What comes next after this? Will we just put people in jail for life upon being accused? After that seems to be accepted, will we just execute them before any trial? I understand people wanting justice but we must be careful when throwing out systems that protect the innocent. I hope we will all think about this and have discussion with others to make sure we don't lead ourselves down this dark path.
title: Slovak businessman charged with ordering murder of journalist Ján Kuciak and his fiancée
